objective: Qualify one complete non-HOLD zero-capital economic lifecycle through the canonical pre-live contracts; do not estimate strategy edge.
hypothesis: A prospectively captured VALID BTC-USD public candle can produce one deterministic BUY-shaped shadow intent, modeled partial fill, economic events, position/P&L projection, declared-shadow reconciliation, immutable receipt, restart recovery, and monitor visibility while actual exposure remains zero.
observation_rule: After frozen_at, capture the latest completed public Coinbase Exchange BTC-USD five-minute candle through the canonical market-data plane; it must not already exist at preregistration time and quality must be VALID.
pass_gate: The captured observation is newer than frozen_at and VALID.
A BUY request is authorized only for SHADOW with capital_effect NONE.
The deterministic adapter produces exactly one MODELED partial fill with explicit fee/spread/slippage/latency assumptions and no randomness.
Accounting events reproduce fill quantity, fees, position and modeled P&L.
Declared-shadow reconciliation is MATCHED while external venue truth remains unavailable.
Duplicate and staged restart tests pass, receipt integrity passes, monitor exposes the lifecycle, and actual financial exposure remains 0.00.
failure_gate: Observation predates preregistration, is duplicated for this experiment, or is not VALID.
Capability or Governor authorization is bypassed.
Any randomness, credential, signer, venue order, actual fill, wallet action, realized ledger entry, or capital movement occurs.
Accounting cannot be reproduced or declared-shadow reconciliation diverges.
Restart produces duplicate events/receipts or loses modeled execution state.
